description_en: Checks whether a database name is unique and conforms to the naming conventions on an instance
description_zh: 该接口用于检查数据库名称是否重复或不符合命名规范
kebab_example: aliyun rds check-db-name-available --db-instance-id rm-t4n3a0000 --db-name test1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CheckDBNameAvailable

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符，且该参数值中不能包含非ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The database name that you want to check
parameters.name: db_name

RequestId.description_en:
The request ID.

If this operation returns only the ID of the request, the database name conforms to the naming conventions. If an error message is returned, the database name is duplicate or does not conform to the naming conventions
RequestId.description_zh:
请求ID。
仅返回请求ID时，表示数据库名称可用，否则会返回报错信息，提示数据库名称重复或不符合命名规范
